blocks.text: South Korean prosecutors have asked police to reinvestigate the death of a woman who received an incompatible blood transfusion at a Seoul hospital in 2024, after police closed the case without charges last month. The Seoul Northern District Prosecutors’ Office asked the Seongbuk Police Station to conduct further inquiries, saying additional facts needed to be established before the case could be concluded. Police plan to reopen the investigation. The woman, in her 50s, was taken to the emergency room of a university hospital in Seoul after going into cardiac arrest in September 2024.
